framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure obligation when acquiring substantial shares; defines timing and content of public announcement.
Triggers mandatory open offer at not less than highest price paid in preceding 6–52 weeks; applies on crossing 25% threshold.
Open offer must be made to all shareholders for minimum 26% shares if acquirer did not hold any shares before; 20% if pre-existing shareholder.
Public announcement requirements; specifies content, form and timing (within 4 trading days of crossing threshold).
Approval by the Board of Directors and shareholders of the target company may be required depending on transaction structure.
Settlement and completion rules; post-offer obligations and delisting provisions if applicable.
Continuous disclosure obligations post-acquisition; acquirer must update shareholding pattern quarterly (Form BSE/NSE CA).

parties: Pramod Kumar Gupta (acquirer); United Drilling Tools Limited (target)
headline: Substantial acquisition in United Drilling Tools Limited by Pramod Kumar Gupta
sum: Pramod Kumar Gupta has made a substantial acquisition of shares in United Drilling Tools Limited (UNIDT), triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The acquirer filed Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a potential open offer or control shift in the drilling-tools manufacturer.
detail: Pramod Kumar Gupta submitted formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating acquisition of a substantial stake in United Drilling Tools Limited. The filing does not disclose the exact percentage or value of shares acquired, but the Regulation 31(4) trigger typically implies crossing or approaching the 25% threshold. The acquirer is now obligated to make a public announcement and launch a mandatory open offer as per SEBI requirements.
